name: production-os
//release: CANONICAL RELEASE PATH, in this order: (1) `npm run verify:release` — every gate in scripts/verify-release.mjs green (the count grows with each ratchet; the script's own header is the source of truth), (2) `rm -rf .open-next .next && npm run deploy`, (3) `npx wrangler deployments list` to confirm the new version. AS OF 2026-10-02 Workers Builds is NOT CONNECTED to this repo (no Git integration in the dashboard), so pushing to main changes the repository and NOTHING else — no build is triggered and `wrangler versions list` shows only CLI-authored versions with zero push_event source. Until the dashboard Git integration is enabled (repo defragapp/production.os, branch main, root /), the CLI below is the ONLY deploy path; do not push-and-hope. `npm run deploy` ships BOTH Workers in one command: it chains `npm run tail:deploy` after the main OpenNext deploy, because sovereign-tail is a SEPARATE Worker with its own wrangler.jsonc and its own version stream. That chain is load-bearing, not cosmetic: redaction on the Tail Worker was committed to git and still never reached production, because only the main deploy ran. Gate 33 asserts the chain so the two cannot silently diverge again. If you ever deploy the main Worker by a path other than `npm run deploy` — including any future Workers Builds wiring — you MUST run `npm run tail:deploy` yourself. Do NOT run a CLI deploy while a push-triggered build is in flight — colliding builds stall static-asset binding propagation (the 503/hang seen on /, /privacy, /terms).

scripts.deploy: opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy && npm run tail:deploy
